_why: Campaign 1 of the IA modern-English series (#4966): the introduction and development of yoga in English print, 1800–1930 — Orientalist translations of Patanjali (Ballantyne 1852, Dvivedi 1890, Judge 1889, Woods 1914), the Vedanta Society lecture books (Vivekananda, Abhedananda, Paramananda), the Theosophical reception (Besant, Judge), the New Thought repackaging (Ramacharaka = W. W. Atkinson), the Tantrik texts (Woodroffe / Arthur Avalon), and the sceptics (Carrington, Oman). Sanskrit and Hindi originals are OUT — they are held hidden already and are not cheap.
